Toggle Hover Corpse Loot
Master toggle enabling or disabling the Hover Corpse Loot HUD window.
Toggle Condition % on Item Icons
Show item condition percentage and progress bars on eligible icons in the Hover UI.
Toggle Parts condition dots on Weapons & Armors
Show internal component condition indicator dots on weapons and outfits in the Hover UI.
Toggle Repair type Icons on Weapons & Armors
Show compatible repair kit type badges on weapons and outfits in the Hover UI.
Toggle Faction patch Icons on Armors
Show faction patch badges on stalker outfits in the Hover UI.
Hover UI Horizontal Offset from crosshair (OFFSET : X)
Horizontal screen offset in pixels from the center crosshair to the Hover UI window.
Hover UI Vertical Offset from crosshair (OFFSET : Y)
Vertical screen offset in pixels from the center crosshair to the Hover UI window.
Hover UI Horizontal Size (X Axis)
Total horizontal width in pixels of the Hover UI window.
Opacity of the Hover UI Window
Background opacity percentage of the Hover UI window.
Activation Delay for Hover Corpse Loot UI
Delay in milliseconds while aiming at a corpse before opening the Hover UI window.
Maximum distance from corpse to activate Hover UI
Maximum distance in meters from the targeted corpse at which the Hover UI activates.
Item icon selection background color
Color tint applied to the currently selected item cell highlight in the Hover UI.
Item icon selection color brightness
Brightness intensity percentage of the selected item highlight color.
Cursor Acceleration
Clamps the Cursor step speed to mouse scroll wheel speed.\n[DEFAULT = 1.0] 1:1 Cursor to scroll wheel step speed.\nEvery value increment increases cursor acceleration by 10%.
Universal Modifier Key

Rebind the Universal modifier key.
[MODIFIER + MOUSE LMB] = Field Strip weapon parts and attachments.
[MODIFIER + MOUSE RMB] = Disassemble Item.
[MODIFIER + SCROLL WHEEL(UP/DOWN)] = Move the cursor along column (Y-Axis Movement).
[MODIFIER + KEYBOARD NUMBER KEY (1-5)] = Number keys (1-5) maps to (6-0).
Keyboard number key shortcut behavior
Exact Row : Cursor jumps to the exact row shown in the Hover UI.\nItem Kind : Cursor in Hover UI jumps to the item row matching their kind (Weapons = 2, Ammo = 4).
Minimum weapon parts condition to Strip
Minimum condition percentage threshold for internal weapon parts during Field Strip.
